name: rhdh-prow-release-branch
description: Commissions or decommissions the openshift/release Prow configuration for a single RHDH release branch: the ci-operator config `redhat-developer-rhdh-release-{version}.yaml`, the jobs `make update` generates from it, the `release-{version}` branch-protection block in `_prowconfig.yaml`, and the `#rhdh-e2e-alerts-X-Y` Slack channel and `rhdh-send-alert` Vault webhook. Use for "set up CI for release 1.11", "commission the 1.12 branch jobs", or "decommission 1.8". Prow configuration for a release branch only — the release itself is rhdh-release-status, rhdh-release-schedule, and rhdh-release-announce.
